texts.text: <color=#515aee>Ever so cunning... ever unhesitant... and... ever caring.</color>

texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: ... I can't do anything for you if you don't have a numbered ticket.
texts.speaker: B2F Floor Manager

texts.text: [미사용] …지금 몇 번까지 불렀지?
texts.speaker: Queueing Customer

texts.text: Don't even think about cutting in line...
texts.speaker: Queueing Customer

texts.text: How long have I been here...? I've lost track...
texts.speaker: Queueing Customer

texts.text: [미사용] (임시)…쥐어짜지 마. 이제 아무 색도 안 나와.
texts.speaker: Exploited Dye

texts.text: [미사용] (임시)하루에 세 번 짜내지고, 세 번 채워져…
texts.speaker: Exploited Dye

texts.text: [미사용] (임시)…색이 빠진다는 게 어떤 기분인지 알아?
texts.speaker: Exploited Dye

texts.text: I'm busy right now. I've got to finish this before the color starts to turn.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: Oww...!
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: [미사용] (임시)히익…! 팔레트가 보냈구나… 이제 그만…!
texts.speaker: Exploited Dye

texts.text: [미사용] (임시)…도망칠 힘도 없어…
texts.speaker: Exploited Dye

texts.text: [미사용] (임시)드럼통 속이 차라리 편해…
texts.speaker: Exploited Dye

texts.text: [미사용] (임시)우리를 짜내면… 너도 언젠가 짜내질 거야…
texts.speaker: Exploited Dye

texts.text: [미사용] (임시)……(희미하게 떨고 있다)
texts.speaker: Exploited Dye

texts.text: The fabric that hang here are vibrant—they stand out amidst the drab palette of the other clothes in the area.
Someone put a quite a lot of care into gathering these here.
They're standing in line, waiting their turn.
[미사용] <벽에 황금빛 가죽이 걸려 있다. 눈을 뗄 수 없을 만큼 찬란하다.>
A line of tiny customers waits ahead. They'll probably prick us with those needles if we try to squeeze past.
<A passage leading to the dye storage. It's sealed tight for now.>
[미사용] <지하 2층 안내판. '방…장 → 타… 둥지 → 복… → 염색…' …낡아서 잘 보이지 않는다.>
[미사용] (임시)여기는 언제나 안전하단다. 피곤하면 쉬었다 가렴.
[미사용] 지하 3층으로 내려가는 에스컬레이터. 굳게 멈춰 있다.
I found myself considering the same question on the third floor, Executive Manager...
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: But I can't help but wonder what this place's criteria for selecting these two-person detachments might be.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: And of all people, I have been paired with that woman...
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: *puff* I.O.T.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: <Hmm... Maybe it just picks at random.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Despite her communication deficiencies, her combat capabilities are beyond reproach. I will tolerate her, Executive Manager.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: <So... any guesses as to what I.O.T. means?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: ... Decrypting coded communications requires quite a bit of time.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: <No guesses, got it. What about you, Meursault?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Yes, Manager?
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: <Any guesses...? You know what, maybe I'm pushing it too far...>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: It's our turn, Manager.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: <Yeah, I knew it. These abbreviations are impossible to—>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Oho?
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: The Arayashiki quivered.
You...
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: Were you able to decipher that woman's mind-boggling abbreviations all this time?
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: No.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: My comprehension extends only to abbreviations Ryōshū has previously used and that have been interpreted by Sinclair or through other means. New abbreviations remain undecipherable.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: Stop fumbling like a M.B. and tell me W.W.A., Clock.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: The scabbard shakes furiously. Araya must be getting ticked off.
"Stop fumbling like a mediocre bunch and tell me where we're at, Clock."
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: This should somewhat mitigate the communication issues, Executive Manager.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: <Y-yeah...>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <Anyway... This is B2. We should probably make sure we actually came to the right place, though...>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Hahaha, what a bunch of worrywarts. Relax! You're exactly where you want to be.
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: The A.B. is here.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: "Annoying b—"
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: <It's fine, Meursault. I think I have a pretty good guess as to what she meant.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: This floor is where the Skein Nest is, folks. The one that supplies threads only to Le Noir's most illustrious labels.
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: ... How did you get here?
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: Me? Oh, I thought I told you already: I can go anywhere, as long as it's not the Fount.
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: The Chaplain never stops yammering about it, sure... but what choice do I have? It's an awfully tedious thing, having to walk all the way down here on foot!
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: Anyway, just how long are you people planning on dilly-dallying?
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: Any reason we shouldn't D.D.?
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: That was "Any reason we shouldn't dilly-dally?" Manager.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: <About that... I was thinking we'd take our time and look around first.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Ugh. This stupid tick-tocking... Can you do that over there—not so close to me? Things without flesh make me uncomfortable, fancy clothes or not.
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: I seem to have heard a rude comment directed at the Executive Manager that I wouldn't normally let slide, but let me ask you something first.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: ... You've been nagging for a while. What are you plotting?
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: Really now? Haha! You really don't know what's coming for you? That snuffling, don't you hear it? It's so loud!
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: My word... Poor little dears. You have no clue, do you?
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: You'd better start running if you're really that clueless... Not that it'll help, but what else can you do?
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: <... Did she just walk into that wall?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: We've hit a D.E. My scabbard isn't enough to cut through it, and the sword refuses to be drawn.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: ... We should scout the area and locate this "Skein Nest," Executive Manager.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: <Do you know where it is, Meursault?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: The map is quite worn, but we will be able to reach our destination if we follow the route to the right.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: <Good. Let's be on our way.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Back already...? It hasn't been that long since you went down...
texts.speaker: เกรกอร์

texts.text: Some enraged thing chased us down and killed us. Wasn't all that exciting.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: <... Not sure about the enraged part, but yeah, that's what happened.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: That thing was enraged, C.H.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: I can't say why I'm so sure about it, but there was no mistaking the emotion pouring out of it.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: <Either way, that clears up what's making that "snuffling" sound Kromer was talking about. It's probably...>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Yes, Executive Manager. There is a high probability she meant that cocoon.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: Outis and Ryōshū glared at the Golden Cocoon wriggling on Meursault's shoulder.
If it's still wandering nearby... we will need countermeasures.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: It's blocking the route necessary for our advance. We will not be able to outmaneuver it by sprinting alone.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: Um... Did you happen to run into that Kromer woman again?
texts.speaker: ซินแคลร์

texts.text: She suddenly appeared out of thin air, mocked us, and then walked into a wall before we could retort.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: <... She didn't seem to be planning to attack us, at least not at that moment... Just like when we first met her.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <But yeah, she didn't seem interested in lending any help either...>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: N.O.W.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: ... Never off watch... Yeah. She's a Kromer, after all. Can't let our guard down.
texts.speaker: ซินแคลร์

texts.text: <Let's head back out and look for another way.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Died again, huh?
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: See? I warned you—that snuffling is much, much too loud.
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: That monster... Is it still prowling this area?
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: No. It went flitting off somewhere else. If it does return, it will have to take the long, long way around.
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: You see, since it's so far away, it'll have to press its ear to the ground and creep along if it wants to track this snuffling down.
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: Hehe, now that that's sorted, you're all free to dilly-dally like you wanted!
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: <... It's not like we dawdled because we wanted to.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Hm? Oh... Is it almost time for the next stranding? How diligent.
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: What is that supposed to mean...?
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: You don't know when the stranding hour is? You strangers haven't the slightest clue about anything.
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: *puff* We've been patient enough, Clock. Time to S.H.N.C.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: <... Yeah, maybe it's time we seriously considered S.H.N.C.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: The scabbard sways from side to side, as though it were shaking its head in an emphatic "no."
*chuckle* I'll be back when the time is ripe. In the meantime, make sure you don't die in spectacularly comical ways when I'm not even there to watch the show, hm?
texts.speaker: พี่สาวโครเมอร์

texts.text: *puff* She went through the wall again.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: ... I'd much rather converse with Jeanne's disembodied voice than run into that woman again.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>My, my. Did you miss my voice that badly?</color>
You seem to be fond of making an appearance without so much as a hint. Do you just enjoy playing god, or have you been indulging yourself for so long that it's become who you are?
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: Why the "surprise visit"? Are you not already watching our every move from wherever it is you're lazing around?
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>Oh, hardly. I've been so busy that I missed most of what you were saying just now.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>So... Who were you having such a delightful conversation with?</color>
Kromer.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>.......</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>Who? Sorry, you cut out.</color>
<color=#ebcaa2>Must be the speaker messing up again... eh, it does that sometimes. Can I call you back later, ma puce?</color>
Yes.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: <color=#ebcaa2>*chuckle* Ever the gentleman.</color>
<... We should get going as well.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: *whistle*
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: S.N., was it, this place? Lives up to the name.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: <Don't think we'll have to ask around who the Floor Manager is.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: If those Noirs spoke the truth, that one should be capable of producing the Golden Skein.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: <Surely we don't need a higher Prestige Tier just to ask a favor this small, right...?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: As far as I'm aware, Manager, it is required.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: However, given my current tier, our request will likely be accepted.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: ... Your report caused needless alarm. State the relevant conclusion first next time.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: No reason to go this way yet.
It seems we have no further business here.
You're...
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: Ugh, don't you see I'm busy? Buy the queue ticket from someone ahead of you, or pay a premium to buy the Golden Dye back. Just stop pestering me.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: I said, stop bothering me!
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: Thread is being spun. As it spills down, each strand takes on the color of the dye beaded around its nail.
[미사용] 이번 황금염료는 누가 사가는지 들었어?
texts.speaker: Laboring Needlekin

texts.text: [미사용] 다음 대기순번이… 네이키드였나? 르누아르에서 받아간다곤 들었는데.
texts.speaker: Laboring Needlekin 2

texts.text: [미사용] 그래? 그럼 훔치는 건 안 되겠네. 르카키들이었으면 바늘로 찌르고 염료만 가져가면 되는데…
texts.speaker: Laboring Needlekin

texts.text: [미사용] 외관과 달리 살벌한 대화가 오가고 있다.
[미사용] 엿듣고 있는 걸 눈치챘는지, 말 없이 일하기 시작했다.
The customer is hard at work.
[미사용] 이.드. 라는 놈에 대해 아는 대로 말해라.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: [미사용] 이드? 네이키드?
texts.speaker: Laboring Needlekin

texts.text: [미사용] <…알아들었는데?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: [미사용] 지하 2층을 돌아다니는 그 재수 없는 르누아르를 말하는 거야?
texts.speaker: Laboring Needlekin

texts.text: [미사용] 그놈이라면 자주 원단을 보러 시장에 와.
texts.speaker: Laboring Needlekin

texts.text: [미사용] 시장이라면… 천을 잔뜩 쌓아둔 그 복도를 말하는 건가?
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: [미사용] 맞아!
texts.speaker: Laboring Needlekin

texts.text: [미사용] 무슨 일이십니까, 이방인들.
texts.speaker: Queueing Noir

texts.text: [미사용] 음. 그런 염료는 전혀 들어보지 못했습니다.
texts.speaker: Queueing Noir

texts.text: [미사용] 그래도 팔레트는 알고 있지 않겠습니까? 이 층의 염료는 모두 팔레트가 관리하고 있으니.
texts.speaker: Queueing Noir

texts.text: [미사용] 건투를 빕니다.
texts.speaker: Queueing Noir

texts.text: Back again, strangers?
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: I've got to say, I'm surprised. Naked got his Golden Dye—I was expecting you guys to show up with a ticket soaked in his blood.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: We have reached an agreement with that man. He is willing to exchange his Golden Dye for a dye named L'Incolore.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: L'Incolore...? You mean the deep-sea dye?
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: Where'd he even pick that up? Hardly any customers remember it anymore.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: How long must we wait to receive that dye?
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: You don't have to wait. Deep-sea dye doesn't have a queue. I can't even remember how many seasons it's been since anyone bought it.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: <Guess we're lucky for this one.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Do you still remember how to make it?
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: Of course. But... I'm not giving it away. It's a huge hassle to make that stuff, you see.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: If eyeballs would suffice—
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: Keep your eyeballs. What I need you to do... is go burst some blubber-bubbles into tears.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: Bawl each color out twice. That should do it.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: Back already? Hey, I've got to give it to you—you burst those tears better than I expected.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: Putty, bring me the batch we made earlier.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: Here. Take it.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: The old dye you asked for.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: ... Is this some kind of joke?
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: What? You asked for L'Incolore. You're looking at it.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: But there's—
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: Can't see it, can you? Maybe your memories have picked up too much stain, or maybe your heart's pilled beyond recognition.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: ... *sigh* I see what's happening here. Executive Manager, what color does this dye appear to you?
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: <It... just looks like a bucket of transparent liquid to me, too.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Don't give me that look. It was a joke. A joke, I swear. Did you really think there's such a thing as a color only the pure of heart can see?
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: <... What?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Even if it were real, the world wouldn't be any different.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: Colors are painted to be seen, you know? By other people. And purity of heart? Innocence? Doesn't take long for those kinda things to go poof once those same people are birthed into this world.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: And we end up with yet another world where no one can see its color. It's meaningless by definition.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: So it is.
texts.speaker: อูทิส

texts.text: It's just a colorless something. You can't really dye anything with it.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: Mind you, though, I didn't just scoop up a bucket of whatever and call it a day. Producing it is one hell of a process.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: S.L.O.P.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: What do you mean, "slop?!" Do you have any idea how much work went into that dye?!
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: I'm saying it's not water-based.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: "Seems Like Oil Pigment." Judging by the viscosity and the weight.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: ... R-right...
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: ... It doesn't even leave any stains.
texts.speaker: เรียวชู

texts.text: Of course not. It is transparent.
texts.speaker: พาเล็ตต์

texts.text: Nodding along, Ryōshū picked up the bucket of dye Palette had placed before her and marched straight toward the door.
Where do you think you're going?
texts.speaker: อูทิส
